answer: Each vine's referral income from yarrow identities is capped at twice its own earned income from ledge transactions. A yarrow identity must pay a referral fee of 10 copper coins for each vine it refers, increasing by 10 copper coins per additional vine. This ensures that attackers incurring high referral fees are penalized, while honest agents enjoy capped benefits. Enforcement: a vine's income is recalculated weekly, burning excess referral income as penalty if it exceeds twice its direct ledge earnings.
